cards.text: Moses just told the LORD that speaking to Pharaoh only brought trouble on the people, and the LORD answered that now Moses will see what He does to Pharaoh. God isn't done talking, and He opens with this: “I am the LORD.” Friend, when God starts with His name, you put the cookie DOWN and you listen.

cards.question: God says He appeared to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, Israel's forefathers, as God Almighty. Which name of His did He NOT make known to them?

cards.text: Then God brings up the covenant He set up with those three. The deal: He would give them the land of Canaan.

cards.question: Canaan was the land where Abraham, Isaac and Jacob lived as ___.

cards.text: God says He has heard the groaning of the Israelites, the ones the Egyptians are enslaving. I spent YEARS in the back of a junk drawer, friend, and groaning was basically my cardio.

cards.question: God has heard the Israelites groaning, and He says He has remembered His ___.

cards.text: So God hands Moses a message for the Israelites, and it is LOADED with “I will.” He will bring them out from under the yoke of the Egyptians and deliver them from their bondage.

cards.question: God tells the Israelites He will redeem them. How does He say He'll do it?

answers.text: With an outstretched arm and mighty acts of judgment
With a peace deal Pharaoh is happy to sign
With silver and gold paid to the Egyptians

cards.text: And God isn't just getting them out of Egypt. He says, “I will take you as My own people…”

cards.question: God says He'll take the Israelites as His own people. What does He say He will be to them?
God circles back to that old promise. True or false: He says He'll bring the Israelites into the land He swore to give Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, and give it to them as a possession.

cards.text: Moses carries every one of those “I will” promises straight to the Israelites. You'd think somebody would start throwing sprinkles.

cards.question: True or false: The Israelites listen to Moses.
What does the text give as the reason the Israelites don't listen to Moses?

answers.text: Their broken spirit and cruel bondage
They think Moses made it all up
They would rather stay in Egypt

cards.text: So the LORD sends Moses to Pharaoh king of Egypt with one message: let the Israelites go out of his land. And Moses? Moses has a question about that.

cards.question: Moses pushes back on going to Pharaoh. What's his reasoning?

answers.text: If Israel won't listen why would Pharaoh
Pharaoh is far too powerful to face
The Israelites are not ready to leave

cards.question: Moses also tells the LORD that he is unskilled in ___.

cards.text: Then the LORD speaks to Moses and his brother Aaron. He gives them a charge about the Israelites and Pharaoh king of Egypt: bring the Israelites out of the land of Egypt.
Now the story pauses for a family tree: the heads of the houses of Reuben, Simeon and Levi. Down Levi's line, Amram married his father's sister Jochebed, and she bore him Aaron and Moses.
After all those names, the text points right back at them: it was this Aaron and Moses the LORD told to bring the Israelites out of Egypt, and they're the ones who spoke to Pharaoh king of Egypt.
Back to the day the LORD spoke to Moses in Egypt. He said, “I am the LORD; tell Pharaoh king of Egypt everything I say to you.”

cards.question: True or false: Moses answers the LORD with the same worry he raised before, that he is unskilled in speech.

cards.text: Same worry, round two, and friend, I RESPECT it, because that's me hitting snooze the second time like the alarm hasn't heard this one. The LORD answers, “See, I have made you like God to Pharaoh…”

cards.question: The LORD has made Moses like God to Pharaoh. What role does He give Moses' brother Aaron?
Moses is to speak all that God commands, and ___ is to tell Pharaoh to let the Israelites go out of his land.

cards.text: Then God tells them how this is going to go, and spoiler: it's not one meeting and done. He says He will multiply His signs and wonders in the land of Egypt.

cards.question: God says He'll multiply His signs and wonders in Egypt. What does He say He will do to Pharaoh's heart?
True or false: God says that once He multiplies His signs and wonders, Pharaoh will listen to Moses and Aaron.

cards.text: Then God says He will lay His hand on Egypt and, by mighty acts of judgment, bring the divisions of His people out of the land of Egypt. That's not a nudge, friend. That's the whole hand.

cards.question: When God stretches out His hand against Egypt and brings the Israelites out, what will the Egyptians know?

cards.text: After all that back and forth, here's the part I love. Moses and Aaron did just what the LORD had commanded them.

cards.question: When Moses and Aaron speak to Pharaoh, how old is Moses?
When Moses and Aaron speak to Pharaoh, Aaron is ___ years old.

cards.text: Eighty and eighty-three, friend, and I thought I was WASHED UP when my edges went blurry! We'll leave it here for now, but trust me, Pharaoh hasn't heard the last of these two.
